name: Maaseiah (Father of Azariah who worked on the wall in Nehemiah 3:23, son of Hananiah)
title: Son of Hananiah and father of the wall builder Azariah
summary: Maaseiah was the son of Hananiah and the father of Azariah, who participated in the rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah's leadership. He is mentioned in the genealogy in connection with the wall work in Nehemiah 3:23. Although little is known about his own life, his family was actively involved in the restoration of Jerusalem after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of the wall builders
keyEvents.description: Maaseiah is mentioned as the son of Hananiah and the father of Azariah in connection with the listing of those who rebuilt Jerusalem's wall.

keyEvents.title: Azariah's work on the wall
keyEvents.description: Maaseiah's son Azariah carried out repair work on the wall next to his own house, as part of the coordinated rebuilding led by Nehemiah.

keyEvents.title: The rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall is completed
keyEvents.description: The great project of rebuilding Jerusalem's wall, in which Maaseiah's family contributed, was completed in just 52 days despite strong opposition.

keyEvents.title: Nehemiah's organization of the wall work
keyEvents.description: Nehemiah organized the people to rebuild the wall around Jerusalem and assigned the work among various families and groups, including the descendants of Ma'asejah.
